title: Limited Drop Alert Video Template | AIVideosUGC
description: Drive urgency for a small release or restock with a drop alert video from one product photo. Add your date, quantity and notify link after download.
h1: Limited Drop Alert Video for a Restock or Small Release
lead: Place the release product in a scene, and add the date and stock note only after download.
steps_h2: Make a Limited Release Ad in 3 Steps
steps_lead: The scene shows the product. The date, quantity and notify link stay editable after download.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo of the item in the drop. Keep its shape and color fully visible.
Describe one reveal or in-use action, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the alert and add the date, quantity and notify link in your editor. Pause the ad when stock runs out.

faq.q: Is a limited drop alert video only for shoes?
faq.a: No. A shoe drop video fits, and so does a small apparel release, a beauty shade or a home restock. Keep one product and one action in the scene.

faq.q: How do I build the alert?
faq.a: Upload a clear photo of the release item, describe the reveal, pick a size and length, download, then add the date and quantity yourself.
The scene comes from one product photo, so you can prepare the alert before the release without booking a creator for every colorway.
Shops with a short release window on TikTok, Reels or a product page, including shoe and clothing drops.

faq.q: Can a first-time seller use it?
faq.a: Yes. One clear photo and a short scene description are enough. You add the live details after the file is ready.

faq.q: Can the clip show a live countdown or the stock count?
faq.a: Add the countdown, date and quantity as text after download. The generator does not keep a clock or a stock number in sync.

faq.q: Which size and length fit a drop post?
faq.a: 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 for a feed, plus 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4 when you need them. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Does it add music or captions?
faq.a: No. Add music, a spoken line and captions in your editor, or in the app where you post.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. You see the cost first, and a failed job returns its credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: What should I do when the drop sells out?
faq.a: Pause or replace the ad and change the quantity line. A limited alert should not keep running after the number is wrong. The download has no watermark, and any person on screen is an AI performer, not a buyer.

steps.sourceHint: Show the full shoe shape and color in a clear view.
steps.prompt: An adult hiker ties the uploaded coral trail shoes on a rocky trail, then stands so the tread and both shoes stay in frame. Leave room above the shoes for a date you add after download.
